name: conv_coil_segment
description: One tokamak field-coil tooth: a TTAN mount holding a CONV(PSCN) cell above an HEAC cooling strip, INSL-backed. Repeat by hand around a torus, swapping ctype to NSCN on roughly every other placement.
why: 2730526 ('Tokamak in TPT', explicitly 'uses FRAY as magnets') builds its confinement ring from CONV cells that convert incoming particles to alternating ctype=PSCN/ctype=NSCN around the loop -- an AC-coil abstraction: CONV@144,205(PSCN), @223,206(NSCN), @365,207(NSCN), @445,205(PSCN), @539,206(PSCN), @603,206(PSCN). 2919792 repeats the same CONV(PSCN/NSCN) idea at smaller scale. No existing module models a magnetic-coil segment; the blueprint compiler has no trig so a true circular repeat isn't possible -- this is one placeable tooth, meant to be hand-placed at each coil position the builder chooses.
source: save 2730526, coil-ring context x138-230 y198-212 (CONV tmp=15, HEAC@235-247,196 at 22C, TTAN/INSL/METL structure sampled in the same box)
